title: Entry Key Registry
description: Schema for the generated entry_key_registry.json produced by 'specdev registry-generate'.

$schema.description: Schema URI identifying this document as an entry-key registry. Must be 'vc:entry-key-registry'.

_format_version.description: Semver string for the registry format.

_note.description: Human-readable note about the registry's origin. Consumers should not parse this string.

registry.description: Map of spec file basename (e.g. '04_fr_list.json') to entry-array metadata.

_sentinels.description: Top-level array names (e.g. 'canonical_refs_used') that appear in multiple spec files and are always corpus-excluded. These are NOT listed per-file in the registry.

steps_without_entry_arrays.description: Steps that have no top-level entry-bearing arrays (neither schema-derived nor deferred).

steps_with_deferred_registration.description: Steps whose entries live in non-canonical per-milestone files rather than spec/NN_*.json.

step.description: Step ID matching an entry in step_order.json::steps[], e.g. '04' or '16a'.

arrays.description: Entry-bearing top-level arrays in the spec file.

array_path.description: jq-style path to the array, e.g. '.functional_requirements'.

id_field.description: Name of the property that carries the entry's unique ID, e.g. 'fr_id' or 'id'.

kind.description: Logical kind of the entry, kebab-case, e.g. 'fr' or 'deliverable'.

nested.description: Nested entry-bearing arrays within each item of this array. IMPORTANT: the `array_path` for each nested entry is relative to each item of the parent array, NOT relative to the root spec document. To compute the full jq filter, concatenate: `<parent.array_path>[]<this.array_path>` (the leading `.` of the nested `array_path` is retained). For example, given `arrays[*].array_path = ".milestones"` and `nested[*].array_path = ".deliverables"`, the full jq path is `.milestones[].deliverables`.

corpus_excluded.description: When true, this array does not contribute to the nearest-id corpus. Only emitted when true.

rationale.description: Human-readable explanation for why this step has no or deferred entry arrays.
